criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1 and 9 strong at feed size; 8 legible as being built; 2 works. 3 a straight-on plate under the dek reads as a chart; 5's neck reads as two bead bands with a gap; 7 an even mid grey field with its label near the edge; 6 one lone rack in a mostly empty frame.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One cyan meaning, copper recurring, dark values throughout, the rack room recurring and 1 and 9 closing the loop; 4 and 5 and the plates 3 and 7 sit in other material worlds.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traced; the comparison honest to c9; two Xeons one step removed; HPCwire reprints; 'Frontera is dark' a shade looser than retired. No fabrication.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A real story about one lab with a named who, but the stake for a Texan is never concrete, nothing to do, no date for Horizon, a rhetorical closing question.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns a swipe; 2 goes back to history; 3 restates the cover; 4 and 5 a science detour; the turn at 6; 9 lands but restates the count.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on the house rules; institutional; the caption opens on a spec-sheet hook; hedges fill body lines; little regional texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Topic and palette fresh; count-led opening and drawing-unit counts familiar; follows no. 72's protein science deck.

one_sentence_fix: Replace frame 3 with a sourced frame on what follows for a Texas reader and end the caption on that fact.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Even mid grey field; label 23 px from the edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Side light falling to near black; label inside the margin.
